verdict.rationale: The platform's literature agent can run deep reviews synthesizing evidence across hundreds of papers with citations, and the client API supports programmatic task submission, which could be scripted to canvass many papers. However, there is no documented feature for systematic screening/extraction with consistent, reusable criteria (e.g., PRISMA-style inclusion/exclusion criteria, structured field extraction across a corpus) — the docs describe ad hoc Q&A or narrative literature review tasks rather than a batch screening/extraction pipeline. missing for 10: explicit systematic-review/screening workflow support, structured extraction schema across papers, evidence of consistent-criteria application at scale.
